The '''Clines family''' consisted of [[Willer Clines]] and his two daughters, [[Flaenella Clines|Flaenella]] and [[Jastina Clines|Jastina]]. They lived in [[Tazan City]]. Willer and Jastina supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
